detail.longDescription: Rootns provides: 1. A subset of detached namespaces. 2. A dedicated PID namespace for spawning into, signaling members, and polling/waiting on init exit. 3. Initially an empty mount mount namespace that must be populated before going live. The first class design principle has been to minimize the amount of new boilerplate that OCI runtimes would require. #linux #kernel #container #podman #docker
